gap_cause_wealth: The Black-white wealth gap comes mostly from discrimination that's still happening today.
The wealth gap comes mostly from the lasting effects of past discrimination, like slavery and segregation.
The wealth gap comes from a mix of past discrimination and differences in choices, families and culture.
The wealth gap comes mostly from differences in choices, families and culture, not discrimination.
gap_cause_arrests: Black Americans are arrested at higher rates mostly because of bias in policing and courts.
The difference comes about equally from bias and from differences in crime rates.
The difference comes mostly from differences in crime rates, driven by poverty and neighborhood conditions.
The difference comes mostly from differences in crime rates, driven by family and culture.
gap_cause_tests: Test score gaps between racial groups come mostly from biased tests.
Test score gaps come mostly from unequal schools and resources.
Test score gaps come mostly from differences in family income and neighborhood conditions.
Test score gaps come mostly from differences in family structure and culture.
college_admissions_race: Colleges should consider race as one important factor in admissions, to increase diversity.
Colleges should be able to consider race only as a minor factor, like a tie-breaker.
Colleges shouldn't consider race, but can consider economic hardship instead.
Colleges shouldn't consider race or any other group characteristic at all.
hiring_race: Employers should consider race as one important factor in hiring, to increase diversity.
Employers can consider race only to break a tie between equally qualified applicants.
Employers shouldn't consider race, but should recruit in many different communities.
Race should play no part in hiring at all.
contract_set_asides: Government should set aside a fixed percentage of contracts for minority-owned businesses.
Government shouldn't set aside contracts by race, but should help small or disadvantaged businesses of any race.
Government shouldn't run special contracting programs for any group.
workplace_diversity: Large employers should run programs with specific hiring targets for racial minorities and required diversity training.
Large employers should reach out to and mentor minority candidates, without hiring targets.
Large employers should only offer general training on treating everyone equally.
Large employers shouldn't run these programs, but each company can choose.
Companies with federal contracts should be barred from running these programs.
dei_offices: Public universities should have diversity, equity and inclusion offices, and expand them.
Public universities can keep these offices, but they should focus on equal treatment for everyone.
Public universities should close their diversity, equity and inclusion offices.
reparations: The federal government should make cash payments to each eligible descendant of enslaved people.
The federal government should provide reparations through programs like housing, education and business grants, not cash.
There shouldn't be payments, but the government should formally apologize and officially study the question.
The government shouldn't do anything beyond today's laws.
local_redlining_compensation: Cities that enforced housing segregation should compensate the people harmed and their descendants.
Those cities should compensate only people they personally harmed who are still living.
Cities shouldn't pay compensation for past housing segregation.
hate_crime_sentences: Crimes motivated by hatred of someone's group should carry much longer sentences.
Hate-motivated crimes should carry somewhat longer sentences.
Hate-motivated crimes should carry longer sentences only when they're against people, not property.
The same crime should get the same sentence, whatever the motive.
race_districts: States should have to draw majority-minority districts wherever a minority group is large and close together enough.
States should have to draw these districts only where there's evidence of past voting discrimination.
Districts should be drawn without considering race.
teach_racism_history: Schools should teach racism as central to the American story, including how it shapes society today.
Schools should teach racism as an important part of history, alongside the nation's progress.
Schools should teach the full facts of slavery and segregation, but not as the defining story of the country.
teach_institutional_racism: Public schools should teach as established fact that racism is built into American laws and institutions today.
Public schools should teach that idea as one view among several.
Public schools shouldn't teach that racism is built into American laws and institutions today.
discrimination_black: Black job applicants face discrimination because of their race almost every time they apply.
Black job applicants face racial discrimination most of the time.
Black job applicants face racial discrimination about half the time.
Black job applicants sometimes face racial discrimination, about 3 times in 10.
Black job applicants rarely face racial discrimination today.
discrimination_white: White applicants rarely face discrimination because of their race today.
White applicants sometimes face racial discrimination, about 3 times in 10.
White applicants face racial discrimination about half the time.
White applicants face racial discrimination most of the time.
White applicants face racial discrimination almost every time they apply.
discrimination_groups: This group faces little or no discrimination today: {case}.
This group faces some discrimination today: {case}.
This group faces a lot of discrimination today: {case}.
tribal_sovereignty: Tribes should fully govern their own lands, including non-Native people there.
Tribes should govern their own members, with limited authority over non-Native people on tribal land.
States and the federal government should have more control over tribal lands than today.
disparate_impact: A test that leads to far fewer hires of one race should be illegal unless it's clearly necessary for the job.
It should be illegal only if a fairer test would work just as well and the employer refused to use it.
Only intentional discrimination should be illegal; unequal results alone shouldn't be.
confederate_monuments: Public monuments honoring Confederate leaders should be removed.
Confederate monuments should be moved to museums, with historical context.
Confederate monuments should stay, with historical context added.
Confederate monuments should stay as they are.
